name: Why would I choose a lower countertop height?

mainEntity.name: Why would I choose a lower countertop height?

acceptedAnswer.text: Lower countertops are primarily chosen for enhanced accessibility and comfort. They provide a more ergonomic workspace for individuals in wheelchairs, children, or those with specific physical needs, allowing for easier food preparation, dining, or other activities. Some homeowners also prefer a lower height for a unique design aesthetic or improved interaction in open-concept living spaces.
acceptedAnswer.description: Lower countertops enhance accessibility for wheelchair users, children, or those preferring a more ergonomic working height.
